meta.title: 雅思写作学术词
meta.description: Task 1/2 高频学术词汇与话题词汇：趋势描述、利弊、政府政策、教育、科技、环境、健康

words.sentence: There was a significant increase in online sales.
words.sentence_cn: 线上销售显著增长。

words.sentence: Excessive screen time is detrimental to children's health.
words.sentence_cn: 过长的屏幕时间有害儿童健康。

words.sentence: Regular exercise is beneficial to both body and mind.
words.sentence_cn: 规律运动对身心都有益。

words.sentence: Genetically modified food remains a controversial issue.
words.sentence_cn: 转基因食品仍是一个有争议的问题。

words.sentence: Some job losses are inevitable as automation spreads.
words.sentence_cn: 随着自动化普及，一些岗位流失不可避免。

words.sentence: Solar power is now a feasible alternative to coal.
words.sentence_cn: 太阳能如今是煤炭的可行替代品。

words.sentence: Cities must pursue sustainable transport policies.
words.sentence_cn: 城市必须推行可持续的交通政策。

words.sentence: Rapid urbanisation has transformed rural communities.
words.sentence_cn: 快速的城市化改变了乡村社区。

words.sentence: Globalisation has reshaped local labour markets.
words.sentence_cn: 全球化重塑了当地劳动力市场。

words.sentence: Rampant consumerism fuels waste and debt.
words.sentence_cn: 无节制的消费主义助长浪费和债务。

words.sentence: The gap reflects deepening inequality in income.
words.sentence_cn: 这一差距反映出收入不平等的加深。

words.sentence: Education is the most effective way out of poverty.
words.sentence_cn: 教育是摆脱贫困最有效的途径。

words.sentence: Youth unemployment doubled after the recession.
words.sentence_cn: 衰退之后青年失业率翻倍。

words.sentence: Investment in infrastructure attracts foreign companies.
words.sentence_cn: 基础设施投资吸引外国公司。

words.sentence: Government expenditure on health rose steadily.
words.sentence_cn: 政府卫生支出稳步上升。

words.sentence: Tourism generates substantial revenue for the city.
words.sentence_cn: 旅游业为该市带来可观收入。

words.sentence: Farmers receive subsidies to keep prices stable.
words.sentence_cn: 农民获得补贴以稳定物价。

words.sentence: New legislation bans single-use plastics.
words.sentence_cn: 新立法禁止一次性塑料。

words.sentence: Stricter regulation is needed for online advertising.
words.sentence_cn: 网络广告需要更严格的监管。

words.sentence: Enforcement of the ban has been inconsistent.
words.sentence_cn: 禁令的执行一直不一致。

words.sentence: Young offenders often need support, not punishment.
words.sentence_cn: 年轻违法者往往需要支持而非惩罚。

words.sentence: Rehabilitation programmes reduce reoffending rates.
words.sentence_cn: 改造项目降低了再犯罪率。

words.sentence: Long sentences act as a deterrent to potential offenders.
words.sentence_cn: 长期刑期对潜在违法者有威慑作用。

words.sentence: The curriculum should include practical skills.
words.sentence_cn: 课程体系应包含实用技能。

words.sentence: Vocational training leads directly to employment.
words.sentence_cn: 职业培训直接导向就业。

words.sentence: Science and engineering are core disciplines.
words.sentence_cn: 理工科是核心学科。

words.sentence: Small class sizes boost student motivation.
words.sentence_cn: 小班教学提升学生学习动力。

words.sentence: Music training enhances cognitive development.
words.sentence_cn: 音乐训练促进认知发展。

words.sentence: Sedentary lifestyles increase health risks.
words.sentence_cn: 久坐的生活方式增加健康风险。

words.sentence: Obesity rates among children have tripled.
words.sentence_cn: 儿童肥胖率增长了两倍。

words.sentence: Poverty and malnutrition often go hand in hand.
words.sentence_cn: 贫困和营养不良常常并存。

words.sentence: Life expectancy varies sharply between regions.
words.sentence_cn: 各地区预期寿命差异巨大。

words.sentence: Obesity has been described as a modern epidemic.
words.sentence_cn: 肥胖被称为现代流行病。

words.sentence: The welfare system protects the most vulnerable.
words.sentence_cn: 福利体系保护最弱势的群体。

words.sentence: Officials must be subject to public accountability.
words.sentence_cn: 官员必须接受公众问责。

words.sentence: Greater transparency would restore public trust.
words.sentence_cn: 更高的透明度将恢复公众信任。

words.sentence: Corruption diverts funds from essential services.
words.sentence_cn: 腐败将资金从基本服务中挪走。

words.sentence: The exploitation of workers remains widespread.
words.sentence_cn: 剥削工人的现象仍然普遍。

words.sentence: There is a growing disparity between rich and poor.
words.sentence_cn: 贫富差距日益扩大。

words.sentence: Trade has brought prosperity to the region.
words.sentence_cn: 贸易给该地区带来了繁荣。

words.sentence: Consumer spending fell during the recession.
words.sentence_cn: 衰退期间消费支出下降。

words.sentence: Automation threatens millions of manual jobs.
words.sentence_cn: 自动化威胁着数百万体力岗位。

words.sentence: Factory workers face redundancy as plants close.
words.sentence_cn: 工厂关闭，工人面临裁员。

words.sentence: Young entrepreneurs need access to start-up capital.
words.sentence_cn: 年轻创业者需要启动资金。

words.sentence: Innovation drives long-term economic growth.
words.sentence_cn: 创新驱动长期经济增长。

words.sentence: The vaccine represented a major medical breakthrough.
words.sentence_cn: 该疫苗是一项重大医学突破。

words.sentence: Artificial intelligence is transforming the workplace.
words.sentence_cn: 人工智能正在改变职场。

words.sentence: Gene editing raises serious ethical questions.
words.sentence_cn: 基因编辑引发严肃的伦理问题。

words.sentence: Good policy is a compromise between cost and quality.
words.sentence_cn: 好的政策是成本与质量之间的折中。

words.sentence: The population is predominantly rural.
words.sentence_cn: 该人口以农村为主。
